nodes.label: desktop memory - storage versus working data layout

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. A:\exjobbet\data\raw is cold storage and is not touched at all, on the user's directive 'do not touch A:\exjobbet\data\raw at all, that is the storage' - no writes, no derived views placed next to it, no working with it; reads to verify byte-identity are fine and writes never are. The working area is v3/data: v3/data/raw/<dataset> is the full data the evaluators read truth from in place, and v3/data/corpus/<dataset> is the oracle-stripped RAG-safe split the pipelines retrieve over, both re-derivable or re-copyable from cold storage. Storage is the recovery point; everything under v3/data can be regenerated, so any tool or script that derives, splits or rewrites dataset files targets v3/data. CANON_AUDIT.md lists this among the grounded, verbatim-quoted and correct desktop entries
